verdict.rationale: v0's docs describe it as an AI agent that creates full-stack apps from prompts: it scaffolds full-stack apps, plans, connects to databases such as Neon, Supabase and Upstash while it builds, and deploys in one click. A community user reports building a working internal app with auth, roles and export and putting the MVP in users' hands by Monday. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how backend logic (API routes, auth, data models) is generated from a natural-language description.

support.subject: As a founder, I can describe an app in natural language and get a working full-stack application

citations.quote: v0 is an AI agent that helps anyone create real code and full-stack apps and agents.
Quickly scaffold full-stack apps or components following best practices and modern standards.
v0 plans, creates tasks, and connects to databases as it builds.
Available integrations include databases like Upstash for Redis and Neon for Serverless Postgres, backend services like Supabase, and AI model providers.
Deploy with one click to secure, scalable infrastructure powered by Vercel.
Built a feature-rich internal app (time tracker w/ auth, roles, export) and had a working MVP in users' hands by Monday.
